name: Lemon Herb Baked Salmon
directions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment. Place the salmon on the sheet and drizzle with olive oil. Top with minced garlic, salt, pepper, and lemon slices. Bake for 12-15 minutes until the fish flakes easily with a fork. Sprinkle with fresh dill and serve.
